module: Small auxiliary controller for an electric hydraulic unit: sets the electrics value motorThrottleElectricsName to 1 as soon as one of the listed command values is non-zero, otherwise to 0 (to power the pump motor only when a hydraulic function is requested).
notes: jbeam keys: controlElectricsName (name or list of names of electrics values to watch), motorThrottleElectricsName (name of the output electrics value; no default value: nil would cause an error).
